scope.mutation_policy: Only mutate L:/Continue/Viv during Alpha. Other L:/Continue roots are read for absorption inventory and marked housekeeping_later unless vendored into Viv.

classification_legend.absorb_into_rid: Frequent/default RID surface to become a rid_main.py command.
classification_legend.absorb_into_auto: Frequent/default agentic surface to become an auto_main.py command or Viv-local lib used by it.
classification_legend.absorb_into_uml: Frequent/default language/calculator surface to become a uml_main.py command.
classification_legend.keep_in_lib: Implementation library. Mains and consumers import it; it is not an operator CLI surface.
classification_legend.bridge_temp: External code still used during Alpha, target is vendor/reimplement into Viv later.
classification_legend.housekeeping_later: External duplicate/default to clean after Alpha, not during this phase.
classification_legend.edge_only: Demo/visual/test path not core to the Alpha default.
classification_legend.deprecate: Viv-local duplicate entry after absorption; leave stub temporarily.
